_readme: Captured from src/pages/admin/settings.js as it stood BEFORE the settings reorganisation. tests/admin-settings-inventory.test.js asserts the page is still a superset of all of it. Regenerate only to record a deliberate, reviewed removal. sourceStrings is an inventory of authored COPY: five CSS values that the extractor could not tell from prose (grid track lists, a margin) were taken out by hand, because a layout change is allowed to rewrite those.

rewordedHeadings.why: It was the page <h1>, but only the first of five sections is integrations; the old wording now heads that section instead, as "Integrations", and the credential warning that followed it moved there with it.
